title: Launch day: Monday Nov 16
intro: Zlarior (MFFU 50K eval, LIT) and ATLAS (25K eval) trade for real from 02:00 ET. You arm them yourself at the PC (GO_LIVE_EVAL.bat, you type the phrase); nothing on the phone can trade, start or stop a bot.
steps: At 01:45 ET open the Olympus link on the iPhone. The Launch card must say Ready: Zlarior and ATLAS "LIVE, armed", feed fresh, no flags.
In the ntfy app the "Ready for 02:00 ET" push is there (silent). A loud "NOT ready" names what is wrong and its fix.
Anything red: do the one action in its row below. Nothing red: you are done; every entry and exit sends a push.

LIVE, armed

sections.title: What each push means
rows: Ready for 02:00 ET
both bots running and armed, feed fresh, drawdown left per account
nothing
NOT ready for 02:00 ET
something is wrong before the first entry
the fix written in the push (fixed before 02:00: a Ready push follows)
Zlarior 50K / ATLAS 25K trade opened
an entry: side, micros, entry, stop, target, $ risk at the stop
nothing
Zlarior 50K / ATLAS 25K trade closed
the exit: how, +/- $ and R, drawdown left, today's $
nothing
... fill check: ...
NinjaTrader did something else than the bot planned
see the fill check table
FEED STALE
no fresh NinjaTrader bars: no new entries
NinjaTrader: open the MNQ 5-minute chart, right-click > Indicators > LE_BarFeed > Add
Bot down
the bot server on the PC does not answer or report
PC: double-click GO_LIVE_EVAL.bat (it brings the bot back) and type the phrase
Bot stopped
the server runs but the bot is stopped in entry hours
PC: double-click GO_LIVE_EVAL.bat and type the phrase
NinjaTrader closed
NinjaTrader is not running on the PC
PC: open NinjaTrader and log in
50% / 75% of the drawdown used
the eval used half / three quarters of its room
nothing: the bot sizes down by itself
Daily loss limit near
today's loss is at 70% of the daily limit
nothing: the bot keeps its stops
Day Mon Nov 16: +$...
the 16:05 ET day summary per account
nothing
Back to normal
the problem is gone
nothing

sections.title: Fill check flags (after a real trade)
rows: NO STOP at NinjaTrader
the position has no stop order
NinjaTrader now: no stop order on it -> Positions > right-click > Flatten
wrong size
NinjaTrader filled other micros than the bot sent, or the stop covers fewer
NinjaTrader > Positions: not what the bot sent -> flatten it there
entry slippage / stop slippage
a fill more than 2 ticks worse than planned
nothing; tell Claude if it repeats
stop price off / target price off
the bracket is more than 2 ticks from the plan
NinjaTrader > Orders: check the stop and the target
costs above plan
slippage + commission more than 2 ticks a micro above the plan
nothing; the Sunday review looks at it
entry not filled
NinjaTrader refused or never filled the entry: no position
NinjaTrader: Control Center > Connections connected, MNQ chart with LE_BarFeed

stop: Stop everything: double-click STOP_BOT.bat on the PC (orders at NinjaTrader keep their stop and target).
